stem.text: The reaction pathway diagram for a reversible reaction is shown.

stem.alt: Reaction pathway diagram: energy in kJ mol-1 against progress of reaction. The reactant level is lower than the product level, with an energy peak between them. Arrows labelled 50 (from the peak down to the top of the step) and 20 (from the start level up to the product level) are shown.

items: The enthalpy change for the backward reaction is $-20\,\text{kJ mol}^{-1}$.
The activation energy for the forward reaction is $+70\,\text{kJ mol}^{-1}$.
